NL Scholarship

Provider: Dutch Ministry of Education and Nuffic

Degree: bachelor's or master's programmes

Field of study: fields of study listed by each participating institution

Funding Type: The scholarship amounts to EUR 5,000. You will receive this in the first year of your studies. Please note that this is not a full-tuition scholarship.

Eligible Nationalities: Your nationality is non-EEA

Country of study: Netherlands

Eligibility criteria: International applicants apply via the participating institution

Deadline: check the website of the institution for the specific deadlines
